component.name: 7-Zip File Manager
component.summary: File archiver with a high compression ratio

description.p: 7-Zip is a file archiver with a high compression ratio. This is the 7-Zip file manager and its dialogs, ported from Windows to Linux: the original interface in a dark theme, running natively on Wayland.

ul.li: Open, extract, test and create 7z, zip, tar, xz, zstd and many other archives
The 7-Zip context menu in Dolphin, Nemo, Thunar and Nautilus
Drag and drop with file managers and browsers
